name: Slack Notifications
description: Routes Alertmanager alerts to a Slack channel via an incoming webhook.
longDescription:
Registers a Slack incoming webhook URL with the platform so that Alertmanager (or any alerting plugin) can deliver alert notifications to your Slack workspace.

No container is deployed — the webhook URL is stored securely and injected into Alertmanager configuration at runtime.
author: Kleff

config.label: Slack Incoming Webhook URL
config.description: The Slack incoming webhook URL, e.g. https://hooks.slack.com/services/T.../B.../... — the channel is set when you create the webhook in Slack.
